mentions.name: ministar
mentions.description: Astrophotography tool that automates the hard parts of untracked astrophotography. It uses plate solving to help point the camera at a target and live-stacks the resulting images while accounting for Earth's rotation. It is early-stage and the author plans to port it to Linux/Raspberry Pi so a minimal astronomy rig can be built from just a DSLR, a 3-way head, a tripod, a power bank, and a single-board computer.
mentions.source_excerpt: The second thing I'm working on is an astrophotography tool called ministar (https://github.com/galbacarys/ministar).
